senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גָּאַל)vindicator, redeemer, relative entitled to redemption (Lev. XXV, 25 sq.); in general relation.—ג׳ הדם avenger of blood, nearest relation (Num. XXXV, 19 sq.).
units: <cite ref="Makkot 12a:16">Ib. 12ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>אב שהרג בנו בנו נעש׳ לו ג׳ הדם</he> when a father killed a son of his, his (surviving) son becomes the avenger of blood. Tanḥ. Masé 11 <he>וימצא אותו הג׳</he> and the avenger may meet him; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23:13">Num. R. s. 23</cite> <he>ג׳ הדם</he>.

<cite ref="Makkot 10a:8">Macc. 10ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 19:6">Deut. XIX, 6</cite>) <he>בג׳ הדם הכתוב וכ׳</he> the text means the avenger (is not punished); a. fr.—Pl. <he>גּוֹאֲלִים</he>, <he>גּוֹאֲלִין</he>.

B. Kam. 109ᵃ; Kidd. 21ᵃ (ref. to Num. V, 8) וכי יש אדם שאין לו ג׳ is there a person … without relations (heirs)?; Snh. 68ᵇ גואל. B. Kam. l. c.ᵇ; Snh. 69ᵃ בידוע שאין לו ג׳ it is known that the minor has no heirs (offspring); a. fr.—Esp. the redeemer from captivity, also the Lord.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32:8">Lev. R. s. 32</cite> end; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:7:1">Cant. R. to IV, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:1:1">Koh. R. to IV, 1</cite> (ref. to <he>וגֻלָּהּ</he>, <cite ref="Zechariah 4:2">Zech. IV, 2</cite>) one reads <cite ref="C00385"><he>גּוֹלֶה</he></cite> (He emigrates), and one reads <he>גּוֹאֲלָהּ</he> (not <cite ref="C00009"><he>גאולה</he></cite>) her Redeemer (goes at the head of Israel).

Ib. מאן דאמר גואלה פרוקא (not גאולה) he who reads גואלה means ‘the Redeemer’ as it says (Is. XLVII, 4), Our redeemer &c.—Pesik. S’liḥ. p. 166ᵇ אין … אלא בג׳ מלא they will be redeemed only through a complete redeemer (ref. to גואל Is. LIX, 20 written plene).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 26:1">Ex. R. s. 26</cite> beg.; a. fr.—Pl. as above.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:1">Gen. R. s. 85</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145:4">Yalk. ib. 145</cite> <he>מהיכן ג׳ עומדים</he> (not <he>גדולים</he>) whence will the redeemers rise (if not from Judah)? <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ג׳ אני מעוברת</he> I am going pregnant with redeemers (of Israel).
